label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter name flows directly to bar via conditional assignment (always true), then bar is used as a format specifier in response.format(), enabling arbitrary control over formatting which constitutes a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: Parameter name extracted from request and passed to doSomething
Guard (500/42)+196>200 is always true, so param assigned to bar
bar used as format argument in PrintWriter.format allowing XSS via format specifiers
